fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of monthly Gross Sales. NAF Contribution is up to 5% of monthly Gross Sales, currently 0% (no NAF currently established, may be created on 30 days' notice). Local Marketing Expenditure is up to 6% of monthly Gross Sales, currently 5%. Total combined NAF Contribution + Local Marketing Expenditure + Advertising Cooperative shall not exceed 6% of Gross Sales. Advertising Cooperative contributions (if established) count toward Local Marketing Expenditure. POS System fee is currently $2,230/month for base system, subject to increases up to 5% once per calendar year. Dashboard Access License Fee is waived for first license, $10/month per additional license. Music Provider fee currently $200/quarter. Online Training currently $300/year (up to $500 annually). Additional Training currently $1,200/day/person plus actual costs. Compliance Review Fee currently $1,500–$3,500 per audit. Holdover Fee $250/day after expiration of term. Gift Card and Loyalty Program Fees currently $0; up to 7% administrative fee retained by vendor on gift card redemptions.

Music Provider | Currently, $200 per quarter | Upon invoice on a quarterly basis
Online Training | Up to $500 annually; currently $300 per year | Annually upon invoice in the first quarter
